citations.claim: pole exceeded upright limit at first violating step, cart at x~0.51

counterfactual.change: set sensor_noise from ~0.01078 to 0, keeping all else identical; controller then stabilizes pole

explanation: With coarse dt~0.018 and sensor_noise~0.011, noisy angle/rate feedback causes mistimed forces (e.g. force ~13 at step 20 while theta~-0.64, omega~-3.19) that fail to arrest the fall, so theta diverges to -0.824 rad by step 24 exceeding 0.8 limit. Removing noise alone restores stability, confirming noise-induced destabilization at large dt.
vision_note: The pole leans to the left of upright and its tilt grows progressively from step 21 to 23. In step 24 the pole is tilted furthest and highlighted in red as the violating body while the cart stays near the track center.
